name: ClawHub
summary: The public registry for OpenClaw, hosting SKILL.md-based skills and a catalog of OpenClaw plugin packages. Users browse, search, install, pin and publish through the website or the clawhub CLI. Uploads are scanned with VirusTotal after a wave of malicious skills in early 2026.
facts: VirusTotal checks since Feb 2026; daily re-scans
goodFor: Finding and installing skills for OpenClaw
watchOut: Hundreds of malicious skills found in early 2026
Scanning does not catch all prompt-injection payloads
Install telemetry on by default when logged in
